mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT t.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t."record_id" DESC) AS rn FROM ( SELECT "record_id", "user_id", "uname", "borrow_record"."book_id", "book_title", "borrow_date", "return_date" FROM BOOKMAN."borrow_record" left join BOOKMAN."user" on "user"."uid" = "borrow_record"."user_id" left join BOOKMAN."book" on "book"."book_id" = "borrow_record"."book_id" ) t ) rt WHERE rt.rn >= #{start} AND rt.rn <= #{end}
